TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET.description: Telegram header secret, 1-256 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

WEBHOOK_PATH_SECRET.description: Different random path secret, 16-256 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

AGENT_WEBHOOK_KEY.description: Agent inbox bearer key; only the Worker holds it, never give it to the agent model.

SENT_API_KEY.description: Key the agent uses for POST /sent only; never the inbox key. Generate with openssl rand -hex 32.

TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_URL.description: Agent inbox HTTPS URL with a hostname.

ALLOWED_CHAT_ID.description: Required integer Telegram group chat id.

OWNER_USER_ID.description: Required integer Telegram owner user id, also allows owner DMs.
